purpose: Single machine-readable furniture/equipment/object inventory for the Floor 1 hybrid rebuild. Intentional scene objects must be represented here or explicitly treated as generated architectural geometry.
design_formula: V1 interior quality + assembled-building stacking behavior + current Core V2 truth
inventory_rules: Stable IDs survive future mesh/detail upgrades.
Shared-core geometry remains authority over object placement.
Exact supplied Equity Uprise artwork must be used for any branded mark; do not redraw logos.
Items with placement_rule instead of exact coordinates require resolution during the hybrid modeling pass without breaking circulation or shared-core geometry.
Life-safety objects inherit state/access semantics from floor-01-simulation-objects.json.
Furniture/object inventory is a production input to the real 3D environment, not a substitute for the environment.
